svg.text: ESP32 Remote — Direct 120VAC Wiring to Dometic Brisk II
SSR-25DA for compressor | HL-52S for fans + furnace | Supco SFPC freeze stat | DS18B20 freeze sensor
GPIO 39 HIGH → Relay 2 closes → 12VDC reaches SSR DC+ → SSR ON → 120VAC through SSR → Supco SFPC (NC) → Blue wire → Compressor
SSR handles full 120VAC/25A | HL-52S only switches 12VDC at milliamps | Supco SFPC is independent hardware freeze backup
120VAC on SSR output + Relay 3/4 contacts — junction box required
14 AWG minimum for all 120VAC wiring (15A circuit)
SSR-25DA needs aluminum heatsink (~15W dissipation at 12A)
Relay 2 switches 12VDC only (SSR trigger, milliamp current)
Relay 1 (furnace) is dry contact — no voltage on terminals
FAILSAFE: SSR + all relays are Normally Open
ESP32 power loss = all HVAC OFF (safe state)
AC2 (pin 2): Output to SFPC → Blue wire
Software: DS18B20 on GPIO 42 — cut at 32°F, recover at 45°F (5s interval)
Hardware: Supco SFPC on suction line — opens at 35°F, closes at 50°F (passive NC)
NO BACKUP THERMOSTAT — ESP32 power loss = all HVAC OFF — System is fail-safe but not fail-operational
ESP32 RV Thermostat — SSR-25DA + HL-52S Architecture — v2.0
